summary: Commercial sign fabricator and installer in Pasadena; builds and services channel letters, pylon signs and lighted cabinets for retail and industrial customers around the ship channel.

facilityFit.evidence: Crews service lighted cabinets and pylon signs at height every day; the shop lists a 28-ft assembly and paint bay.

signals.text: Job post: sign installer, aerial lift certification required, bucket truck experience preferred.

suggestedAngle: The job post names aerial lifts, so lead with uptime on installs rather than with the machine: one lift that covers a pylon sign and a cabinet service call in the same day.
personalLine: Your crews are up at height on sign installs every day, and a single boom lift keeps a pylon job and a cabinet service call on one machine.
rationale: Daily work at height and a job post that names aerial lift certification explicitly; one recent hiring signal rather than an expansion, so the need is steady rather than urgent.
